summary: On-demand legal-sandbox audit bundle with event-context enrichment and resumable offset manifest
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requests an on-demand audit bundle suitable for a legal sandbox review. Bundle must include a compact chronological slice of tenant activity for a specified time window, per-event contextual metadata (request headers, user-agent, tenant-id), and a resumable offset manifest so the customer can resume forensic playback if a transfer is interrupted.

Impact:
Customer (enterprise) needs this for an external legal counsel review next week. Delay may block their compliance sign-off for production onboarding. No known data loss; this is a delivery/format request.

Environment:
- Redwood hosted prod (us-east-1)
- Customer tenant: orion-prod-42
- Time window requested: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-07T23:59:59Z

Requested deliverables:
1) A compact, ordered JSONL bundle containing events for the tenant with fields: event_time (ISO8601), event_id, event_type, request_id, user_id (pseudonymized), tenant_id, request_headers (redacted for PII), model_id, route, response_status, cost_units, and an event_context object with upstream_headers and caller_ip (CIDR truncated).
2) A separate manifest file (RFC-style) that lists per-batch resume offsets (byte-range and event-sequence token), HMAC SHA256 per-batch, and a signed root manifest using the platform signing key (customer requested ECDSA P-256 signature).
3) Delivery via presigned S3 objects (encrypted with customer-provided KMS key) and a delivery receipt with checksums.
4) Small sample (10 events) in the ticket comments demonstrating field names/format prior to generating full bundle.

Steps to reproduce / how we validated request:
- Customer provided tenant and time window, and a sample CSV mapping of their internal identifiers to Redwood tenant id.
- Support requested confirmation on PII redaction policy and KMS key ARN.
- Note: customer explicitly asked for resumable offsets because their transfer appliance frequently drops large downloads.

Attachments:
- sample-mapping.csv (uploaded to ticket attachments)
- legal-counsel-evidence-schema.pdf (uploaded)
